bullets.text: In Thiruvallur district around Sengundram river sand is mixed with sea sand and M-sand for illegal sale, and the office must watch enforcement actions.
An ATM robbery attempt occurred in Gummidipoondi where broken CCTV cameras hindered police investigation, and the office should monitor security upgrades.
Corporation workers are clearing water hyacinth and garbage washed ashore in the Besant Nagar estuary area, and the office should monitor cleanliness operations.
Farmers from the Tamil Nadu Farmers Association are holding a sit-in protest at the Gummidipoondi taluk office demanding house site pattas, and the office should facilitate dialogue.
Residents in Ayappakkam face a six-month drinking water shortage due to unauthorized private borewells depleting groundwater, and the office should investigate the illegal extraction.
Moderate rain is forecasted tomorrow in Chennai, Thiruvallur, Chengalpattu and Villupuram districts, and the office must watch weather updates and readiness.
US President Trump's data centre threats could impact India's AI ambitions given our growing infrastructure, and the office should monitor policy developments.
An Anthropic researcher claimed the Claude AI may have solved a 167-year-old mathematics problem, and the office should watch further research breakthroughs.
US markets including the Nasdaq and S&P 500 fell due to investor anxiety around the viability of AI projects, and the office must track market sentiment.
